title: oh-my-mlip models.json
description: JSON Schema for models.json. Every model version must carry the four honesty fields: gated, weights, validation, and license_url. These guard against an 'all-validated' overclaim.

^_.description: _meta and any other underscore-prefixed keys are free-form.

^[A-Za-z].description: A framework entry (e.g. MACE, SevenNet, NequIP).

env.description: conda env name; unpack dir under ${OH_MY_MLIP_HOME}/envs/<env>

default_version.description: for a multi-version framework, the version key resolve() selects when version=None; must be one of this framework's 'versions' keys (cross-checked in tests/test_schemas.py + resolve())

env_run.description: key=value env-var prefix; parsed through parse_env_run allowlist — never raw shell

version_entry.description: Per-version data. The honesty fields (gated, weights, validation) plus the weights-provenance fields (weights_fetch, weights_source) are always required. At least one of 'inference' (plain) or both 'inference_sm86'+'inference_sm89' (arch-pinned) must be present. 'finetune' joined the required set in P2b, once all 32 variants carried a classification (AC3 gate).

oneOf.description: Non-arch-pinned version: plain inference array required.
Arch-pinned version: both inference_sm86 and inference_sm89 required.

allOf.description: gated-hf weights_source must be a Hugging Face repo id (owner/name).
url weights_source must be an http(s) URL or the placeholder 'TODO-owner-review' (allowed this increment).

gated.description: true -> weights require accepting an upstream license + HF_TOKEN; never redistributed here

license_url.description: URL of the upstream license page (required when gated=true; null when gated=false)

weights_fetch.description: mechanism by which weights are fetched: 'by-name' (resolved by model name/cache), 'url' (downloaded from an explicit URL), 'gated-hf' (gated Hugging Face repo requiring license acceptance + HF_TOKEN)

weights_source.description: the source value matching weights_fetch: an HF repo id (owner/name) for gated-hf, an http(s) URL (or the 'TODO-owner-review' placeholder this increment) for url, a resolver name/placeholder for by-name

validation.description: host-GPU validation state (guards against an 'all-validated' overclaim)

finetune_entry.description: Per-variant fine-tuning classification (oh-my-mlip 4-feature expansion, P2a). Now REQUIRED on every version_entry (P2b: the AC3 gate is live -- all 32 variants carry a classification, 3 of them a 'demonstrated' verdict from P3's ft_verify runs). A variant inherits its family's fine-tuning facts unless it carries an explicit override here (variant_args, or a fully-restated block for a divergence like UMA-s-1p2-OC22 or DPA-3.1-3M-FT).

enum: documented (generic v1) + code-excavation for eSEN specifics
status.description: doc-honesty state, NOT an execution claim -- see 'demonstrated' for that. 'documented' variants may carry a parenthetical qualifier (inherited-from-family, config-level-only, or v1-generic-plus-excavation) rather than a bare match against the enum root string; validated exactly against the values this registry actually uses.

entrypoint.description: the console command or API this hub shells out to for fine-tuning

selector_kind.description: how the pretrained checkpoint is selected: a CLI flag, or a config file key

selector_path.description: the flag name or config dotted-path that names the checkpoint

semantics.description: the finetune-vs-resume distinction for this variant: which key/flag loads weights only (fine-tune) vs restores optimizer/scheduler/epoch state (resume). Conflating them yields a wrong run that still exits 0.

variant_args.description: extra selector(s) beyond the family's primary selector_path, needed when a SECOND parameter diverges per-variant (e.g. UMA's --uma-task, MACE MH-1's --foundation_head, EquFlash's config_template). Merged by ft_run.py (P3) after selector_path is applied.

runnable_as_installed.description: true iff every script/config/dependency the fine-tune command needs is present in this repo's pinned env, with no git clone and no extra pip install

blockers.description: empty iff runnable_as_installed; otherwise the concrete missing dependency/asset/enum-value, one entry each

licence.description: set only where the fine-tuned checkpoint itself carries a non-permissive licence a user should see before running (e.g. 'CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0', 'ASL'); null everywhere else. Disclosure, not a legal gate -- this repo is MIT and redistributes no weights either way.

reason.description: free-form explanation for a non-trivial classification (code-excavation-needed, not-supported, or a variant that refutes its family's inheritance); null for a plain documented+runnable variant

evidence.description: URLs backing a 'not-supported' status, which asserts an ABSENCE and needs a citation

demonstrated.description: null until P3 records a passing ft_verify.py run for this variant; a 'demonstrated' doc-honesty state is a stronger claim than 'documented' and must never be inferred, only recorded from an oracle
